items.title: 32.3 Dawa ke asar ka tareeqa (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu introduction to mechanisms of drug action (PDF 234).

blocks.text: Mechanism of action yeh hai ke dawa cell ki satah par kaise kaam kar ke apna tibbi asar paida karti hai. Kitab do mashhoor dawaon, aspirin aur penicillin, ka naam leti hai. Aspirin ka COX enzyme ko rokna Class XI ki kitab mein aa chuka hai, is liye yeh chapter penicillin (32.3.1) aur phir opiates (32.3.2) ka mechanism of action batata hai.

blocks.prompt: Dawa ke mechanism of action se kya murad hai?
blocks.explanation: Dawa cell ki satah par kaise kaam kar ke apna tibbi asar paida karti hai.

items: Mechanism of action: dawa cell ki satah par kaise kaam karti.
Aspirin COX enzyme rokti (Class XI); aage penicillin aur opiates.
